meta.title: Event reasoning — CopyStatusListView (instance 1 of 3)
meta.description:
## Event → field reasoning — CopyStatusListView (feeds SendCopyForRepair screen)

- **CopyAdded** → sets copyId/titleId (row identity — narrow, 1 event)
- **CopyReserved / CopyCheckedOut / CopyReturned / CopyReservationReleased** → each updates the per-copy `status` field — this field is a legitimate wide-fan-in roll-up (a copy's live status is by definition derived across its whole lifecycle so far); bundling it with the narrow copyId/titleId identity fields is the explicitly-allowed 'homogeneous list, one id column + one status column' pattern, not the identity-vs-availability antipattern.

This is instance 1 of 3 progressively-scoped copies of the same read model — CopySentForRepair and CopyReturnedFromRepair sit in later columns than this screen's own column, so they cannot be sources here; each subsequent screen (RecordCopyReturnedFromRepair, ReportCopyLost) gets its own later instance that adds the next event, per the 'new copy of the read model' pattern.
